values.nv_about_id_body_1: Netvisor ID is an application for an easy and reliable signing into Netvisor and mobile applications connected to Netvisor. Identification occurs with fingerprint or PIN code. You'll also find useful system information in Netvisor ID. The application is an alternative to signing in with bank or mobile ID.
values.nv_about_id_body_2:
1. Download Netvisor ID app from Apple App Store or Google Play 
 2. Add your own phone number to Netvisor (Own basic settings) 
 3. Connect your Netvisor ID application to Netvisor user account with bank or mobile ID. If you don't have finnish bank or mobile ID, ask your Netvisor user administrator to create an invitation to Netvisor ID
values.nv_about_id_heading_2: How do I get Netvisor ID in use?
